requirements.requirement: The system must include a unit test that verifies recruiting status is rendered before any quality-related content in the MessageBubble component.
The system must include a unit test that verifies condition match information is displayed before any quality metrics.
The system must include a unit test that verifies a visible pass indicator is rendered when a trial meets triage criteria.
The system must include a unit test that verifies a visible fail indicator is rendered when a trial does not meet triage criteria.
The system must include a test that verifies triage explanation text is rendered when provided in the data contract.
The system must include an integration test that verifies triage data passed through ChatWindow is rendered correctly in MessageBubble.
The system must include a test that verifies multiple triage attributes (recruiting status, condition match, explanation) are rendered in the correct sequence.
The system must include a test that verifies no quality score elements appear before triage elements in the rendered output.
The system must include a test that verifies graceful fallback text is displayed when recruiting status is missing.
The system must include a test that verifies graceful fallback text is displayed when condition match data is missing.
The system must include a test that verifies the component does not crash when the entire triage object is null or undefined.
The system must include a test that verifies empty or missing explanation text does not render blank UI artifacts (e.g., empty labels or spacing).
The system must include a test that verifies triage content is conditionally rendered only when triage data is present in the message payload.
The system must include a test that verifies consistent rendering behavior across both pass and fail scenarios within the same component structure.
